title: Majestic 4BHK Villa with Private Pool
description: A stunning 4-bedroom villa nestled in an exclusive gated community in Whitefield. Featuring a private swimming pool, landscaped garden, home theater, and Italian marble flooring throughout. The chef's kitchen with imported granite countertops opens onto a spacious dining and living area. Each bedroom has an ensuite bathroom with premium fittings. The property includes a dedicated home office, two covered car parks, and 24/7 security. Proximity to major IT parks, top schools, and upscale dining makes this a rare opportunity in one of Bangalore's most sought-after addresses.

title: Premium 3BHK Apartment — City View
description: A beautifully designed 3BHK apartment on the 10th floor of a premium high-rise in Koramangala. Panoramic city views from the living room and master bedroom. The open-plan kitchen features a breakfast bar and high-end appliances. The complex offers a rooftop infinity pool, co-working space, and fully-equipped gymnasium. Walking distance to 5th Block restaurants, cafes, and tech hubs. RERA registered. Ready to move in.

title: Sky-High Penthouse with Terrace Garden
description: An ultra-premium duplex penthouse crowning one of Indiranagar's finest residential towers. Spread across the 18th and 19th floors, this 5-bedroom masterpiece features a wraparound private terrace with a Jacuzzi, outdoor kitchen, and lush garden. The interiors are designer-curated with bespoke furniture, smart home automation, and a private elevator lobby. The master suite spans the entire east wing with a walk-in wardrobe and spa bathroom. Entertainer's paradise with a private bar, wine cellar, and home cinema.

title: Boutique Beach Resort — 18 Suites
description: A turnkey boutique resort property 200 metres from Candolim Beach. The property comprises 18 fully-furnished suites, an infinity pool overlooking the sea, a multi-cuisine restaurant with bar, and a dedicated spa. Strong existing bookings across OTA platforms. Annual revenue around ₹1.8 Cr. 24-month ROI potential with current occupancy rates. All required hotel licenses, FSSAI certification, and clearances are in place. Ideal for an investor or hospitality operator.

title: Grade-A Office Space — Fully Fitted
description: A fully fitted Grade-A office space in the heart of HSR Layout's startup corridor. Currently configured for 80 seats with 4 glass-walled conference rooms, an open collaborative area, and a premium director's cabin. High-speed fibre backbone, centralised AC, and 24/7 access. The building features concierge-managed reception, premium amenities, and excellent metro and road connectivity. Suitable for IT, fintech, consulting, or co-working operations. Immediate handover.

title: Spacious 2BHK Flat — Premium Locality
description: A well-maintained semi-furnished 2BHK in one of HSR Layout's most peaceful sectors. The apartment features large windows, a modern kitchen with a chimney and hob, and a private balcony. The gated complex has a swimming pool, gym, and children's play area. 5 minutes to Agara Lake, close to popular supermarkets, restaurants, and the Bommanahalli metro corridor. Available immediately. Professional tenants preferred.

title: Premium Co-Living PG — All Inclusive
description: A fully managed, all-inclusive co-living PG tailored for young professionals and students. Private fully-furnished rooms with an attached or shared bathroom option. Amenities include high-speed WiFi, unlimited home-cooked meals (breakfast & dinner), daily housekeeping, laundry, and Netflix-enabled common TV lounge. 10 minutes to major tech parks. Both short-stay (minimum 3 months) and long-stay contracts available. Female-only wing also available on request.

title: BMRDA-Approved Residential Plot
description: A BMRDA-approved residential plot in a fast-developing layout near Devanahalli, just 10 km from Kempegowda International Airport. The 2,400 sq ft north-facing plot sits on a 40-ft wide road with all utilities — water, electricity, and drainage — in place. Clear title with all encumbrance certificates available. Surrounded by premium villa projects and a proposed metro line. Ideal for end-use construction or short-to-medium-term investment appreciation.

title: Mango Orchard Farm Land — 5 Acres
description: A fertile 5-acre mango orchard farm on the Mysore highway, 90 km from Bangalore. Approximately 200 mature Alphonso mango trees generate seasonal income. The property includes a 2-bedroom farmhouse, a bore well with pump, and a rainwater harvesting structure. Panchayat-approved. The land is registered under SC/ST relaxation norms — available for non-agricultural purchase through approved conversion. Excellent weekend retreat or eco-resort development opportunity.

title: Hillside Coffee Estate Resort — Lease
description: A captivating 8-acre coffee estate turned boutique resort available on long-term lease (5+ years). The property features 12 fully-furnished cottage suites with valley views, a farm-to-table restaurant, an infinity pool, bonfire area, and 2 km of private walking trails. Existing OTA partnerships and strong seasonal occupancy. Full staff and management team in place. A rare chance to operate a running hospitality business in one of India's top hill destinations.

title: Prime Retail Space on MG Road
description: A highly visible ground-floor retail space on MG Road, Bangalore's premier commercial and retail boulevard. With over 22,000 sq ft of combined frontage in the mall block, this 2,200 sq ft unit enjoys maximum footfall and brand visibility. Floor-to-ceiling glass facade, double-height ceiling, rear loading bay, and dedicated service entrance. Suitable for flagship retail, F&B, showroom, or banking. Minimum 3-year lease term.

title: Designer Studio Apartment — Prime Location
description: A stylishly furnished studio apartment perfect for single professionals. The unit features a built-in queen bed, a compact but fully equipped modular kitchen with a microwave and induction hob, and a large wardrobe. Smart TV, high-speed WiFi, and a work desk included. The building has a rooftop terrace and 24/7 security. Walking distance to supermarkets, the BDA complex, and popular cafes. Minimum 12-month lease.

title: 3BHK Independent Villa — Gated Community
description: A charming 3-bedroom independent villa in a quiet, well-maintained gated township. Ground floor features a spacious living and dining area, modular kitchen, one bedroom with attached bath, and a pooja room. The first floor has two large bedrooms with attached bathrooms and a private terrace. The private garden is perfect for evening relaxation. The township offers a clubhouse, swimming pool, gym, and children's park. Just 1 km from the Heelalige metro station.

title: Heritage Hill Bungalow — Ooty
description: A magnificent 1930s British-era colonial bungalow set on 1.2 acres in Ooty's most prestigious neighbourhood. The 5-bedroom property has been tastefully restored to its original grandeur while incorporating modern plumbing, electrical, and kitchen infrastructure. Original teak flooring, fireplaces in every bedroom, a billiard room, and a private tea garden. The estate includes a separate caretaker's cottage. A once-in-a-generation opportunity for heritage luxury living or a premium boutique hospitality venture.
